result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors.

**Change:** one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java` (line 747). A contributor goes into the remainder only if no team matched and `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. That uses the default 180-day threshold. Blank latest-commit dates already count as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so those contributors are kept.

**Unchanged:** configured teams still take all their members, active or not, because the check only sits on the no-match branch.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer compile` succeeded, and `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test` passed with no failures. I did not add a test for the new filter, since nothing in the existing suite exercises `getAllTeams()`. Nothing is committed.
